qualification_dispositions.text: Chromatic Name and Power give the even and odd whole-tone sets, `WT₀={0,2,4,6,8,10}` and `WT₁={1,3,5,7,9,11}`. Stepping by 2 has two six-element orbits. Their twelve-position closure does not assert that twelve pure `3/2` fifths close at seven octaves.
qualification_dispositions.reason: Closure of pitch classes modulo twelve differs from closure of twelve untempered pure fifths. The exact Pythagorean comma survives and rules out the stronger unadjusted tuning identity.

qualification_dispositions.text: The twelve-position architecture has eight inner addresses at `k=1,…,4` and four outer addresses at `k=0,5`. C major selects five inner tones D, E, F, G, A and two outer tones C, B. It therefore draws seven from the full twelve, not seven from the inner eight. The unselected classes are C♯, D♯, F♯, G♯, A♯. Architectural anchors remain playable positions; their title alone does not make them physical nodes of a vibrating material.
qualification_dispositions.reason: The stated major collection has five inner and two outer addresses. Calling architectural anchors physical vibration nodes would require the medium and governing equation absent from that map.

qualification_dispositions.text: Parallel C minor changes the collection instead: E→E♭, A→A♭, B→B♭. In particular E→E♭ moves `(2,0)` to `(1,1)`; it is not a same-position flip.
